question: Which deities should be worshipped on the sky-lotus petals next?
premises: The next step follows the arghya placement.
The location is the petals of the sky-lotus.
The Bhairavas beginning with Asitāṅga are specified.
inference: One should then worship the Bhairavas beginning with Asitāṅga on the petals of the sky-lotus.
plain_english: Then one should worship the Bhairavas, beginning with Asitāṅga, on the petals of the sky-lotus.
